ImageDescription.value:
Beijing Olympics, Men's Beach volley, Final: Phil Dalhausser in white v. Fábio Luiz Magalhães of Brazil

This was the block that scored the final point in the gold medal game for the US Beach Volleyball team at the Beijing Olympics.
